title: A Primer of the Short Baton
summary: Teaches an untrained body to hold a short baton, stand narrow and strike two clean blows without qi.

title: Truncheon Handling for Plain Folk
summary: Drills wrist-loop carrying, short shuffling steps and low strikes so a beginner can keep a truncheon close and useful.

title: Cudgel and Forearm: A Workbook
summary: A workbook of seven forearm and cudgel drills that harden the arms for striking and blocking without any qi.

title: Eight Lessons on the Carrying Stick
summary: Eight short lessons on a carried stick, from the first grip to a controlled shove and a stepping retreat.

title: Wrist, Grip and Short Reach
summary: Builds wrist strength and grip control for short-reach baton work, with six plain drills for the later body stages.

title: Breath and Baton for the Newly Awakened
summary: Sets out breath-led baton drills for a newly awakened beginner whose qi has only just begun to circulate.

title: A Handbook of the Duty Rod
summary: A short handbook of five guard and rap drills for the circulating beginner who carries a rod on duty.

title: Short Rod Lessons with Circulating Qi
summary: Eight baton lessons that add a thin thread of circulating qi to grip, step and strike.

title: The Steady Hand Treatise
summary: A treatise on the steady hand: six measured exercises for holding, striking and checking an opponent with a baton.

title: Stick, Step and Settled Breath
summary: Joins stick work to footwork and settled breath in seven exercises for a beginner who has begun circulating qi.
